description: This file defines the BiometricAuthManager class responsible for handling biometric authentication using LocalAuthentication framework. It provides a method to authenticate the user with biometrics, falling back to device passcode if needed.

classes.name: BiometricAuthManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing biometric authentication processes.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to authenticate the user via biometrics, with fallback to passcode; throws errors if biometric authentication is unavailable or fails.
